m: व्रत—वैकल्य n. imperfection or incompletion of a vow or religious obs˚, Pañcat.
1. व्रत—वत् (व्रत-), mfn. fulfilling or performing a rel˚ vow &c., Kauś.; MBh.; Hariv. &c.
connected with the Vrata called Mahā-vrata, ŚrS.
2. व्रत—वत् ind. like (in or with) the Vrata-milk, KātyŚr.
व्रत—विसर्ग m. conclusion of any vow or observance, PañcavBr. (cf. व्रतादेशन).
व्रत—विसर्जनीयोपयोग mfn. belonging to the conclusion of an obs˚, ŚBr.
व्रत—विसर्जन mf(ई)n. concluding a religious observance, Kauś.; Vait.
